findings.title: readWithDeadline never retries after a timed-out read
findings.problem: readWithDeadline sets a stuck flag on deadline and returns null without reading while the abandoned read is unsettled. The spec (Item 2 / AC4) requires the next refreshNow() to start a fresh read after the deadline; credential-refresh.test.ts:2501 asserts the deviating single-call behavior instead.
findings.impact: With a keychain read that never settles, refresh() and refreshNow() return null for the process life with no log: the superseded check always answers not-superseded and stale cookies persist, partly defeating the double-browser fix. refresh() also consumes the new sign-in stamp before the read, so a null read spends the signal.
findings.recommendation: Do not short-circuit while an abandoned read is unsettled: start a fresh read on the next call, ignore the late result of the abandoned one, and update the test that asserts one store call.
findings.check_notes: cookie-auth.ts readWithDeadline has no stuck flag; each call starts a fresh read, late result of abandoned read dropped. Tests in cookie-auth.test.ts and credential-refresh.test.ts:307 assert fresh read and late-result isolation.

fix.change: readWithDeadline no longer short-circuits while an abandoned read is unsettled; each call starts a fresh read and the late result is dropped
